description: Execute visualization commands sequentially and return correlated node-match/render acknowledgments. success:true means the entire batch was confirmed rendered with no missing targets. Manual walkthroughs return waiting_for_user after the first applied step; later steps have not run. Check progress using action:"status" with the returned requestId. Timeouts, partial matches, skipped/superseded batches and delivery failures are explicit. Always use this instead of parallel individual visual commands. Include labels; waitForUser:true gives users Back/Next/Skip pacing.

action.description: Default: execute. status reads a previous request without dispatching commands.

commands.description: Required for execute: 1–100 commands to execute sequentially

label.description: Human-readable step description shown in control bar (e.g., "Highlighting complexity hotspots"). Auto-generated from command type if omitted.

payload.description: Command payload (same fields as individual tool)

delay.description: Auto-play delay between commands in ms (only used when waitForUser is false). Default: 800.

entryFile.description: Entry file path — if provided and no visualizer is open, auto-opens one

requestId.description: Required for action:status; use the ID returned by execute.

timeoutMs.description: Bounded acknowledgment wait, default 10000 ms. After timeout use action:status; commands may still finish.

waitForResult.description: Default true: wait for completion or a manual pause. false returns queued, which does not establish matching or rendering.

waitForUser.description: Show a "Next" button between commands so user controls pacing. Recommended: true for presentations and audits.

name: visualize_batch
